messages:
Tasha Reed: Heads-up — flagged HorizonEdge: WAU down ~61% week-over-week, active seats 20 -> 6. CRM note: product lead replaced last month. Link: https://redwood.app/d/HorizonEdge/health
Marco Diaz: ouch. Any infra alerts?
Tasha Reed: infra fine. No error spikes. Drop aligns with customer note that they're running a 2-week POC with AltairAI that started 2026-11-03.
Imani Wright: ok that's classic: stakeholder change + competitive POC + usage drop. Recommend we escalate to a playbook: 1) light discovery with new PM, 2) targeted ROI one-pager, 3) short hands-on session to unblock feature parity concerns.
Shardul Rao: can someone pull seat-level activity + token trend? I'll also check whether their dedicated pool recently fell back to shared capacity.
Tasha Reed: quick SQL to pull last 14 days:
```
SELECT date, count(distinct user_id) as active_seats, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE org = 'horizonedge' AND date >= CURRENT_DATE - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC;
```
Marco Diaz: running it. Initial look: tokens drop started 2026-11-05. No p95 latency drift.
notify-bot: Meeting scheduled: "HorizonEdge: quick health & PM sync" 2026-11-09 11:00 PT — invites: PM, Tasha, Marco, Imani :calendar:
Imani Wright: draft outreach (3 bullets) — 1) short readout of observed usage change, 2) ask about goals with AltairAI POC + blockers, 3) offer a 30-min hands-on session + 30-day seat buffer. Sending now.
Shardul Rao: pricing move idea: offer 45-day seat credit + migration assist (2 office hours) if they commit to a 6-month renewal within 45 days. I'll sketch numbers.
Tasha Reed: action items: A) outreach + agenda (Tasha), B) infra/usage brief (Marco), C) pricing/credit proposal (Shardul), D) 1-pager ROI + feature parity doc (Imani).
Marco Diaz: noted. I'll also surface any recent model variant changes and KV cache hit rates.
Imani Wright: prepare the 1-pager to call out 2 quick wins that map to PM priorities (search relevance and throughput). Keep it one page.
Tasha Reed: timeline: outreach EOD today, infra brief by EOD tomorrow, pricing by meeting.
Shardul Rao: agree. High-touch until PM confirms.
Tasha Reed: pinged PM thread with agenda. Will update here after reply.
Marco Diaz: thanks team.
